headline: Nevada becomes the 36th state
post_facts: Its constitution was sent by telegraph
Still known as the Battle Born State

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in eighteen sixty-four... Nevada joined the Union, in the middle of the Civil War.

scenes.label: Virginia City, Nevada
scenes.caption: The silver boomtown, about 1867
scenes.title: Its constitution went by telegraph
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] To beat the clock, its constitution was sent to Washington by telegraph... the longest telegram yet.

scenes.label: Abraham Lincoln
scenes.caption: Photographed by Mathew Brady, 1864
scenes.title: Lincoln wanted Nevada's votes
scenes.text: [softly] President Lincoln wanted its votes, to win reelection and to end slavery.

scenes.title: Still the Battle Born State
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Born in wartime, Nevada still calls itself... the Battle Born State.
